spec_match.rationale: Every edit is a real getPathData() → mutate one value → setPathData() round trip; the browser-serialized d is displayed; Normalize writes getPathData({normalize:true}) back with setPathData (Q became C, handles 7→8 in the flagged run).

interactive.rationale: Pointer drag, arrow-key nudge, numeric fields, normalize, append/remove/reset all exercised and change d live.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Card matches: draggable/keyboard handles, numeric fields, one-button normalize.

edge_cases.rationale: Guards stale handles/indexes after rebuild, non-finite numeric input, removing the initial moveto; does not demo relative-command handles (edited numerically only).

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/4787972240179200 plus the SVG Paths spec anchor.

runtime_evidence.rationale: No chrome-devtools-mcp in this environment: verified with Playwright headless Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12, default flags and --enable-blink-features=SVGPathDataAPI, desktop 1280x800 and mobile 360x740 DPR3 touch; drag via mouse, ArrowRight + Shift+ArrowDown, number field, normalize, add x2, remove, keyboard on rebuilt last handle, reset; 0 console errors; fallback mode labelled 'FALLBACK' and normalize disabled with explanation. Touch dragging not exercised (mouse only).

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts svgpd-editor-native-roundtrip / svgpd-editor-fallback-roundtrip with a float32 tolerance, and svgpd-editor-normalize-write.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only (shared path-demo.css + small inline blocks); every button override sets both background and color; status chips use emerald-dark/rose on paper/stone; no raw hex.

accessibility.rationale: Handles are focusable with descriptive names (7/7 named after rerender) and arrow keys; numeric inputs labelled; announcements debounced. A role=button on a draggable point is an approximation without an activation action; not verified with a real screen reader.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 0px overflow at 360px and 1280px; handle hit circles raised to r=26 user units, measured 44.2x44.2 CSS px at 360x740 DPR3 (headless Chrome 153, default and flagged); 44px numeric fields remain the non-pointer alternative.

openQuestions.title: Exercise touch drag
openQuestions.detail: Playwright run used mouse events; verify pointer capture + touch-action:none with touch on a real phone.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use polite live regions for standard status updates, debounce frequently-changing regions, use role=img + title for non-decorative inline SVG, and provide data tables as alternatives for visual graphics.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Status lines are role=status/aria-live=polite and debounced (250-400ms) where driven by sliders/typing/drag; each SVG has role=img (or role=group for the editor) with a <title>; segment data is always also shown as text/table.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Collapse multi-column layouts on narrow viewports, set min-width:0 on grid children, and wrap long unbreakable tokens.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Shared path-demo.css: .split/.cases grids collapse to one column below 640-860px, min-width:0 on stage children, overflow-wrap:anywhere on code/output; measured scrollWidth-clientWidth = 0 at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800 in both modes.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible draggable SVG control points keyboard
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Dedicated focusable handles with an accessible name mentioning the arrow keys, setPointerCapture + lostpointercapture, primary button only, touch-action:none and user-select:none on the handle only, arrow keys with preventDefault through the same clamped helper, no role=application.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each control point is a focusable SVG <g role=button aria-roledescription='draggable point'> whose aria-label states segment, kind, x/y and the arrow-key steps; pointer drags use setPointerCapture and clamp to the viewBox; arrow keys move 5 (Shift 1) through the same clamp; handles are not rebuilt mid-drag so capture survives. Hit radius is 26 user units (measured 44.2 CSS px at a 360px viewport), meeting the 44px tap-target guidance.

summary: Built and self-reviewed in a cloud session without chrome-devtools-mcp; evidence is Playwright headless Chrome 153 with and without --enable-blink-features=SVGPathDataAPI.
